math.description: Ukusuka kwinqanaba lokuqala ukuya kwelinqabileyo, ziqonde iingcinga zemathematika ezisebenzayo nokusombulula iingxaki zehlabathi lokwenyani ngemisebenzi emnandi.

english.description: Ngaphaya kokulungiselela uvavanyo—funda isiNgesi esisebenzayo kuncoko yemihla ngemihla, ukukhula komsebenzi, ishishini, nohambo lwehlabathi ngemisebenzi emifutshane.

korean.description: Ukusuka kukubhala kweHangul ukuya kwisiKorea seshishini, vula amathuba noqhagamshelwano olutsha ngezifundo ezichazwe ngolwimi lwakho lwenkobe.

physics.description: Imisebenzi yokuhlola ifiziksi ukuze uqonde imigaqo yoomatshini, umbane kunye namandla.

chemistry.description: Imisebenzi yokuhlola ikhemistri ukuze uqonde ubume bento, iimpendulo kunye nekhemistri kubomi bemihla ngemihla.
